asset: ATT optics set (optic_reddot, optic_holo, optic_3x, optic_sniper, optic_thermal), F:/git/val etf/assets/weapons/attachments/optics/ - review round 2 (after the builder's round-1 fixes)
verified_ok: Re-runnable from scratch: a sandboxed copy of build_optics.py (--render none) rebuilt all five .glb, catalog.json, fitcheck.json and the baked textures BIT-IDENTICAL to the delivered files (review/round2/_rebuild/rebuild_compare.txt, rebuild.log).

Every .glb and .fbx loads; one root empty ATT_<optic> at the mount origin, one child node per role (_Body/_Glass/_Objective/_Ocular/_Display/_Reticle/_Glint/_StatusLight), ATT_<optic>_SOCKET_ADS with zero rotation; node extras (eye_relief_m, *_node) present; FBX dims/ADS identical to glb, scale 1.0, PNGs packed (checks_r2.json).
ADS heights above rail top 0.049 / 0.045 / 0.050 / 0.0405 / 0.052, all inside the 0.04-0.075 band; dims match catalog.json exactly.

Sniper matches Warden BRIEF 4.4: length 0.380, axis 0.0405, rings +-0.060, bell r 0.034, ice ring r 0.0355 (paint, not emissive), sunshade r 0.030-0.033 to -0.235, elev turret top 0.0905, windage on -X, side focus on +X, eye point socket+0.085 = brief local (0, 0.230, 0.0405).

Topology: all bodies, glass and lenses are closed 2-manifold in optics.blend and in the glb (merge-verts import); 0 inverted islands; 0 coplanar z-fight candidates; decals sit 0.05 mm off the glass (topo_rail_r2.json, decal_gap_r2.json).

glTF materials: one primitive per material, base-colour textures embedded (512 px, LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR, repeat), no KHR_texture_transform, doubleSided false everywhere, glass BLEND alpha 0.30, emissive only on reticle/glint/status LED, sniper has none.

On-gun snap: socket in sockets.json == socket node in mako_base.glb / warden_base.glb (0.0 mm) for both guns; 0 clash triangles for every compatible optic; Mako and Warden rail tops are exactly at the socket z (dense 1 mm probe: max 0.00 mm, slots -3.00 mm).

issues.issue: 1x reticles are sub-pixel geometry and read white: holo dot 10 MOA = 2x2 px at 1080p at the game ADS FOV (62.4 deg vFOV), its 68 MOA ring has a 4 MOA (1 px) line that stair-steps without AA; reddot dot (0.19 mm disc, 10 MOA) is 2x2 px. Emission 1.6 x (0.45,0.85,1.0) clips to ~(225,255,255), so the reticle is a near-white speck with almost no contrast on bright ground/sky.
issues.evidence: review/round2/sheets/reticle_zoom_x4.png (x4 crops of r2_ads_optic_holo_onmako_1080p.png, *_noAA.png, r2_ads_optic_reddot_onmako_1080p*.png); checks_r2.json reticle_diam_mm 0.19 (reddot), 1.68 (holo); centre pixels (225,255,255).
issues.fix: Size the reticles for the screen, not real MOA: dot ~18-20 MOA (5-6 px at 1080p), ring line >= 8 MOA (2+ px), keep the ~68 MOA ring. Better: one reticle quad per sight with an emissive, alpha-masked 128 px mipmapped texture (filters instead of aliasing) plus a thin dark outline ring for contrast. Use emissive strength ~1.0 and a deeper ice like (0.15,0.75,1.0) so the core stays ice-blue after tonemapping. Re-measure on 1080p ADS renders (target: dot >= 5 px, ring line >= 2 px, visible on sky AND pale ground).

issues.issue: Holo (Mako default) ADS sight picture is a small tunnel: the clear window is 28% of screen height x 22% of width at eye relief 0.08 and the bone hood covers about half the screen (fitcheck screen_clear_frac 0.508). Eye relief cannot be lowered: the hood runs 45.5 mm behind the reticle, so at 0.065 the hood rear is 27.6 mm from the eye and the game's 0.03 near plane clips it. The reddot is similar: 24% x 15%.
issues.evidence: review/round2/renders/r2_ads_optic_holo_onmako_1080p.png, r2_ads_optic_reddot_onmako_1080p.png; review/round2/ads_window_r2.json (eye relief sweep 0.04-0.10 with near-plane check); fitcheck.json ads_aperture.
issues.fix: Agree with the game session on a target (e.g. clear window >= 40% of screen height for 1x sights). Then either (a) add ads_viewmodel_vfov_deg (~44 deg for holo/reddot) to catalog.json and the socket extras, so the engine renders the viewmodel with its own FOV/near plane during ADS (standard FPS practice), or (b) shorten the holo tunnel behind the glass by ~10-12 mm, flare the rear opening to the view cone so the lining walls stop showing, and drop eye relief to 0.065 (about 33% height) while staying outside the 0.03 near plane. Re-render the ADS views at 1080p.

issues.issue: optic_holo face details drift from v09 (the master reference): v09's window sits in a thick black inner bezel inside an inward-chamfered bone frame; the model has a thin 1.2 mm dark lip on a flat bone face, so it reads as a 'white box with a hole'. v09's large dark rubber guard wrapping the deck's +X front corner is a small square boss with a hole on the model. v09's flat deck with one proud round button became a recessed tray that reads as a hollow tub at 3/4. There is also no hood-to-base split line.
issues.fix: Front: add a 2.5-3 mm black bezel step between the bone frame and the glass and a 45-deg inward chamfer on the bone frame (keep the brow >= 3 mm solid, the build already asserts it). Deck: replace the tray pit with a 0.8-1 mm inset panel, with the big round button standing proud as in v09. Make the +X front-corner rubber guard a wrap-around angular piece (~12 x 10 mm) as painted. Add a 0.6 mm seam where the hood shell meets the base. Re-check with the v09-angle comparison sheet.

issues.issue: The third-person glint (strength 2.2) also clips to white. In v09 the glint is a clearly saturated cyan oval, the Mako's only emissive identity.
issues.evidence: renders/ATT_optic_holo_three_quarter.png and compare_holo_three_quarter_vs_v09.png (white dot vs cyan); gltf_json_r2.json M_ATT_IceGlint emissiveStrength 2.2.
issues.fix: Lower the glint to ~1.0-1.2 with a deeper ice emissive (0.15,0.75,1.0) and/or add a faint ice halo disc (r ~2.5 mm, low strength) behind the core so it reads cyan in Blender (AgX) and in Bevy (TonyMcMapface).

issues.issue: Bone reads cool white/grey, not v09's warm beige. The baked M_ATT_Bone albedo averages sRGB (184,180,170) (matches the M_MAKO_Bone token, so consistency is right), but in the studio and range renders the hood measures about (198,200,200), B >= R, against v09's lit bone (216,209,202) and shade (185,177,162), where R exceeds B by 14-23.
issues.evidence: pixel samples: renders/ATT_optic_holo_three_quarter.png median (198,200,200); art/concepts/mako/v09.png (950,190)=(216,209,202), (980,250)=(185,177,162); gltf_json_r2.json image mean.
issues.fix: Not on the optic alone: palette owner + Mako owner change the shared bone token together (e.g. linear (0.52,0.47,0.38)) and judge it under the game's tonemapper. The optic follows via the one M_ATT_Bone line. Until then, render the comparison sheets with Standard/Filmic instead of AgX Medium High Contrast so the review sees the real hue.

issues.issue: From the front and front-3/4 (what enemies see) the optic_sniper objective reads as an empty black tube: the lens sits 57 mm down the sunshade, which is lined in near-black M_ATT_Dark (0.016). The strong blue objective that sells 'sniper' in Warden concept_34 is lost; only the ice ring carries the read.
issues.fix: Keep the brief geometry. Line the sunshade/bell interior with graphite (or a dark slate ~0.06) instead of M_ATT_Dark, and push M_ATT_LensObjectiveDeep to a saturated blue around (0.03,0.10,0.32), rough 0.08, clearcoat 1, so the lens shows as a blue disc at 3/4 like concept_34. No emissive (the sniper must stay non-emissive).

issues.issue: The faces a right-handed player actually sees at hip (holo hood top and rear) are big blank bone planes. Under bright light they go nearly pure white with no detail rhythm.
issues.fix: Add one or two readable secondary forms on the top and rear: the hood/base seam from the bezel issue above, a shallow 1 mm rear-face frame chamfer around the eye window, and a low raised rib or recessed cap on the hood top. Keep it to a few crisp cuts (style guide: big forms + few details).

issues.issue: optic_thermal eye_relief_m 0.025 leaves only 1.1 mm of margin: the nearest body point (eyecup rim) is 31.1 mm from the eye point and the game camera near plane is 0.03 m. Any forward ADS sway or recoil push will clip the eyecup.
issues.evidence: review/round2/ads_window_r2.json optic_thermal 0.025: eye_to_nearest_body_mm 31.1; game/crates/val_etf/src/render.rs PerspectiveProjection near 0.03.
issues.fix: Set eye_relief_m to ~0.040 (the engine draws the thermal view on _Display anyway), or document that the viewmodel needs its own near plane <= 0.01 (same request as the holo ADS issue).

issues.issue: optic_3x reads front/back-ambiguous in profile: the objective bell and the rubber eyepiece have nearly the same mass. At 64 px its side silhouette ('block with a tube at each end') is close to optic_thermal's.
issues.fix: Make the read directional: lengthen and flare the objective bell (~+8 mm, +2 mm radius), shorten the eyepiece to a stubby rubber cup (~-6 mm), and give the housing a forward-sloped top so the 3x tapers toward the shooter. Recheck the 64 px silhouettes.

issues.issue: The hand-off summary is stale. It reports tris 2452/4002/4180/4644, but the delivered files (and NOTES/catalog) are 2436/4454/4546/4696.
issues.fix: Correct the summary sent to the orchestrator and user. The asset itself needs nothing.

verdict: Accept as a prototype set with two required gameplay fixes. Technically very solid: deterministic rebuild (bit-identical glbs), valid glTF/FBX, correct sockets and node roles, rail fit verified on both real guns, closed manifold bodies, all budgets met, and the sniper matches the Warden brief to the millimetre. Before it ships as the Mako default, fix the two ADS-facing problems: the sub-pixel, white-clipping 1x reticles, and the holo's tunnel-like sight picture (agree a viewmodel FOV / eye-relief target with the game session). Then polish the holo face toward v09 (black bezel step, corner guard, flat deck) and the sniper's black-hole objective.
